extracted.intended_audience: nonprofits, foundations, government agencies, and corporations evaluating or procuring social-good technology
extracted.subtask_description: Marketing/homepage content describing a social-good technology platform and its value propositions for nonprofits, funders, government, and corporate CSR programs. Focus is on product claims, impact metrics, and trust/ethical positioning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Built for everyone / accessibility and inclusivity
rubrics_metrics.description: The only social good technology built for everyone
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Positioning implies the product should be broadly accessible and suitable across sectors and organization sizes; marketing emphasizes universal applicability rather than narrow specialization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Integrated platform across fundraising, case management, CSR, grantmaking
rubrics_metrics.description: Unites nonprofits and funders with powerful software designed for impact. From fundraising to case management to CSR, we power the changemakers who better the world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Criterion favors end-to-end solutions that cover multiple mission functions (fundraising, case management, CSR, grantmaking) and enable organizations to manage disparate needs within one suite.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audience-specific solutions
rubrics_metrics.description: For nonprofits / For foundations / For government / For corporations — tailored solutions for each stakeholder type.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The product should offer features and messaging targeted to different user groups (nonprofits, foundations, government, corporations) rather than one-size-fits-all functionality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trust and credibility
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evidence of trust (network size, client logos, testimonials) is expected; credibility is supported by large-scale adoption metrics shown on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scale and reach (data/evidence-backed impact)
rubrics_metrics.description: 40M+ Donors; 170K+ Nonprofits in our network; $28B+ Annual giving supported
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluation should consider scale metrics and empirical evidence of platform reach and financial throughput as indicators of maturity and reliability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Responsible, agentic AI with human oversight
rubrics_metrics.description: First agentic AI built for social good. Built responsibly for mission-driven work, Bonterra Que learns from millions of interactions and over $28B in annual giving to deliver tailored insights and recommend confident, accurate action — always under human guidance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: AI features should be trained on appropriate domain data, provide tailored actionable insights, and include explicit human-in-the-loop governance and ethical safeguards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Innovation combined with ethics, transparency, integrity
rubrics_metrics.description: Most innovative, ethical software. Built with transparency and integrity at its core, our software helps mission-driven teams work smarter, move faster, and create meaningful change, together.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Product claims should balance novel capabilities with commitments to ethical behavior, transparency of operations, and institutional integrity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Large, connected data network and data clarity
rubrics_metrics.description: Largest data network in social good, supporting every mission. Strengthen your grantmaking with social good technology that connects your partners, clarifies your data, and turns every program into measurable progress.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Platforms should provide connected datasets, clarify/centralize data, and enable measurable program outcomes; emphasis on data-driven decision making and partner connectivity.

rubrics_metrics.name: End-to-end tools enabling accuracy and impact measurement
rubrics_metrics.description: Backed by the most expansive data network in the industry, Bonterra offers end-to-end tools for fundraising, CSR, grantmaking, and case management, giving doers of good everything they need to take action with accuracy and impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluation favors platforms that provide the full workflow (end-to-end) and instrumentation to measure accuracy and impact across program stages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Security of case management and data
rubrics_metrics.description: Deliver life-changing services with secure case management tools and social good software that streamline processes, unlock funding, and help move communities forward.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Security for case management and sensitive client data is an explicit requirement; tools should secure workflows while improving efficiency and access to funding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Measurable outcomes and testimonial-backed results
rubrics_metrics.description: Customer outcomes highlighted (e.g., '800% More sustainers', '223,013 Veterans Served', '70+ Countries')
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Claims of effectiveness should be supported by concrete outcome metrics and customer testimonials that illustrate tangible program results and retention/scale improvements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grantmaking centralization and process visibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Bonterra Grants Management created a one-stop location where we can easily view every step of the process and centrally manage all of our data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Effective grantmaking solutions should centralize workflows and provide visibility into each step of the grant lifecycle to improve management and oversight.

rubrics_metrics.name: Employee engagement and partnership strengthening for CSR
rubrics_metrics.description: Drive greater impact with CSR and grantmaking tools that engage your employees, strengthen your partnerships, and turn every investment into measurable community results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CSR features should facilitate employee engagement and partnership management and enable measurement of community impact from corporate investments.
